review_candidates.title: IT Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Responsibilities Prioritize and track issues to resolution, update the internal knowledgebase and communicate learning with relevant business units. Maintain an up-to-date inventory of computer equipment, accessories, software, licenses and associated records. Develop and maintain a knowledgebase of known issues and solutions to fully leverage team experience and best practice. Troubleshoot, diagnose and resolve technical hardware and software issues. Maintain the telecommunications system.
eligibility_evidence: Job Purpose Provide onsite and remote IT support for all computers, peripherals, data applications and networking problems at company locations.
Assist in network and cabling upgrades and offices relocations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Education Diploma in Computer Science or a similar field Minimum 5 years’ experience in an IT helpdesk or technical support environment Job Requirement Change, Release and Deployment Process Incident, Problem Management and Support Knowledge Management, Training and Enablement Call Support Hardware and Software Provisioning and Support MS Office Products (2016+) Network Connectivity Operating Systems (Windows 7,8,10+) Printing and Scanning Services Specialized Application, Petroleum Applications Telephony and Communication Systems User Account and Computer Management Certifications Skills Physical Requirements
